title: Can I SURVIVE Duck Chess?
summary: chess.com Duck Chess vs online humans: each turn a player makes a normal move and then must move the uncapturable duck to a different empty square; the duck blocks movement. No check/checkmate — you win by capturing the king (so you may move into 'check' and block with the duck; stalemate impossible since the duck always moves). Tony plays several games, is eventually paired with a 2700 and loses.
rules: After every move, the mover must place the duck on any empty square other than its current one.
Duck can't be captured and blocks all pieces (no jumping over except knights jump normally).
No check rules: king may move into attack; game ends when a king is captured.
win_condition: Capture the opponent's king (won at least one per title goal; final game lost vs 2700).
